data.title: 轻井泽惠 · 宿舍床榻的泪眼深情告白
data.description: 反锁的单人宿舍内，红色制服外套与领带早已松解，露出诱人锁骨。被你按在床榻上的惠眼泛热泪，紧紧抱住你的脖子热情深吻，断断续续地抽噎喘息着“从今往后……惠的整颗心和身体都只属于你”。
data.location: quiet locked dormitory bedroom with drawn blinds
data.action: pinned on single dorm mattress with red blazer unbuttoned, hugging partner neck desperately with tears of relief, kissing passionately while yielding completely
data.lighting: soft dim floor lamp casting warm amber glow on disheveled bed
data.mood: cathartic emotional vulnerability, passionate redemption, desperate devotion
data.promptProse: Pinned on dorm bed with an unbuttoned blazer, Kei Karuizawa clings to partner neck with joyful tears, kissing passionately in warm amber light.
data.animaCaption: Kei Karuizawa clinging with tears of joy and passionate embrace on bed.
